name: Launch nibbler
description: Takes a very small, capped position in one new token: 50 cents a buy, $2 a day, $10 in total, and only under a price you set. Replace NEWTOKEN with the ticker or BSV-21 id, and buyBelowUsd with your limit, before loading. New tokens often go to zero; treat the $10 as gone.
goals: Buy tiny amounts of the named new token, only at or under the buy limit, never more than $0.50 at once. Do not chase the price after a jump.

spec.trades: One new BSV-21 token you name
spec.often: A few times a day at most
spec.needs: The token's ticker or id and your price before loading
